verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report from the CrowdStrike outage, where users recovered with Windows System Restore and 'last known good configuration'. That shows Windows has a built-in rollback mechanism, but no first-party documentation in the pack describes snapshots or update rollback, and it was called impractical at scale. Missing for 10: first-party docs on System Restore/restore points, a documented update-uninstall or rollback workflow, details on snapshot creation and retention, and corroboration beyond one thin community mention.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can roll back the system to a previous snapshot if an update breaks something

citations.quote: Another said a Windows system restore helps, but isn't practical across an environment of ~500 or more clients.
